code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin). There is mild renal impairment (creatinine high), and mild coagulopathy (elevated INR). Differential blood count reveals monocytosis and basophilia. These findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possibly due to infection or another inflammatory process, with evidence of hypoxia and mild renal and hematologic involvement. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
